install.effects: Frozen dependency installation with the pinned pnpm and lockfile.

setup.effects: Builds Lamp, migrates local data, saves private settings, claims the first owner through Base operator-auth and initializes product settings.

dev.effects: Serves Lamp locally with Base keyed owner dev identity and silently suppressed mail.

preview.effects: Serves the fixed production build locally. Sign in locally with rer dev.

build.effects: Builds the production Worker and assets with private local settings set aside.

verify.effects: Runs Lamp's complete local verification: source, Workers, browser and generated-artifact checks; no hosted acceptance claim.

reset.effects: After confirmation removes local data, owner, generated private settings and installer state; keeps source, exports and deployment receipts.

deploy.effects: Runs Lamp's Cloudflare pipeline: input validation, resource setup and migrations, build, secret upload, Worker deploy and health check. Full verification runs separately with rer verify. --dry-run builds and validates locally with no provider request.

export.effects: Writes the local D1 data and R2 snapshots to a new owner-only archive with an integrity receipt. export:cloudflare covers a deployed installation.

import.effects: Restores a verified archive into an empty local installation after --yes. import:cloudflare covers a deployed installation.

release.effects: Base release producer: receipts, validation and gates; never pushes or deploys.

doctor.effects: Read-only tool, configuration and state diagnostics naming missing inputs.

describe.effects: Describes commands, flags, pins and local state without running project commands.

authentication.deployment: Owner-controlled Cloudflare API token and account ID.
authentication.operators: Base operator-auth native email links with a confirmation POST; optional owner-linked OpenID Connect; keyed local owner identity in development.

health.semantics: App-host dependency health; local input checks never assert deployed health.
